answer: Require each identity to keep a mirrored record: every juniper check must be matched, within the same short window, by a cedar review that re-derives the same conclusion in reverse order, so the two halves mirror each other. One operator cannot tend many mirrors at once, and a farm that splits juniper work to one clone and cedar work to another breaks the mirror and earns nothing. Each identity therefore needs its own full, simultaneous mirrored pair, while rewards stay per pair, not per account.
